text: "6.45 Uhr Abschnitt nördlich M 46 bis C 11 Feindangriff in mindestens Div.-Stärke auf breiter Front nach stärkster langanhaltender Art.-Vorbereitung (auch auf Versorgungswege und Hintergelände)" (06.45: enemy attack in at least division strength on a broad front, after the heaviest and longest artillery preparation, also on supply routes and rear areas). The squares are the January edition's and are not decoded.
source: XIV Panzer Corps, tactical reports: 5. Geb.Div., Tagesmeldung vom 12.1.1944

text: The French Expeditionary Corps (2nd Moroccan and 3rd Algerian Divisions) attacked on 12 January toward Atina and Sant'Elia, on the Fifth Army's right. Context: that the German report of 06.45 describes this attack is inferred from the date and the sector.
source: Blumenson, Salerno to Cassino (U.S. Army in World War II), p. 313

text: "At 1225A fired at 2 ME 109's, 12rds 40mm & 80rds 50 cal expended. No hits claimed, withheld fire as 4 Spitfires appeared in range."
source: Battery G, 67th CA (AA), morning report (record of events), 12 Jan 1944

text: "Rege beiderseitige Fliegertätigkeit, Jabo-Angriffe auf D 14, M 06, D 12, M 28, Strasse C 02 - H 11. Vereinzelte Luftkämpfe. Durch schwere Flak wurde um 14.30 Uhr fdl. ein Flugzeug abgeschossen." (Lively air activity on both sides; [enemy] fighter-bomber attacks on D 14 ... Isolated air combats. Heavy Flak shot down an enemy aircraft at 14.30.)
source: XIV Panzer Corps, tactical reports: Arko 414, Zwischenmeldung vom 12.1.1944

text: "At 1435A fired at 2 ME 109's, 91rds-40mm & 425 rds 50 cal expended. One destroyed."
"2 ME-109 mission unknown flying north over area, no hits. Time 1450A."
source: Battery F, 67th CA (AA), morning report (record of events), 12 Jan 1944

text: "12 ME-109 bombing mission, 2 planes destroyed, 1500A. Heavy shelling all day."
"At 1500A fired at 12 FW 190's, dive bombing, 206 rds 40mm & 1035 - 50 cal expended. Two destroyed. One plane exploded and disintegrated in mid-air, the other lost wing and fell to earth."

"Beiderseitige Fliegertätigkeit, besonders rege am Nachmittag ... Über dem mittl. Korpsabschnitt vereinzelte Luftkämpfe. Am Nachmittag wurde ein Feindbomber durch Flak abgeschossen." (Air activity on both sides, especially lively in the afternoon ... isolated air combats over the corps' central sector. In the afternoon an enemy bomber was shot down by Flak.) "Eig. Verschuss 4800." Weather: heavy ground mist, clearing at midday, hazy, generally good visibility. No German air attack or German aircraft loss is reported.
source: XIV Panzer Corps, tactical reports: Arko 414, Tagesmeldung vom 12.1.1944

text: "Nella parte occidentale del fronte dell'Italia meridionale il nemico ha esteso i suoi attacchi anche al settore situato a nord di Venafro. Attacchi lanciati contro le nostre posizioni montane, dopo una forte preparazione di artiglieria, sono stati respinti con elevate perdite per il nemico, mentre due infiltrazioni locali sono state arginate." (In the western part of the southern Italian front the enemy also extended his attacks to the sector north of Venafro. Attacks launched against our mountain positions after a heavy artillery preparation were repulsed with heavy losses for the enemy, while two local penetrations were sealed off.) The communiqué of Berlin, 13 Jan, for 12 Jan; it says nothing of German air attacks in Italy that day. The other side's claim.
source: La Stampa, 14 Jan 1944, p. 1 (the German communiqué, Berlin, 13 Jan)
